summary: Aditxt subsidiary Ignite Proteomics entered a business combination agreement with SPAC Copley Acquisition Corp. The SPAC will re-domicile to Delaware, then merge into Pubco Ignite Proteomics Holdings; Ignite will merge into a Pubco subsidiary, becoming the surviving entity. SPAC security holders will receive substantially equivalent Pubco securities, and Ignite security holders will receive Pubco consideration. No exact per-share price, premium, or stake was disclosed. The board recommended the transaction. Regulatory and closing timelines were not detailed. Key watch items include shareholder approval, SPAC redemption risk, and post-combination valuation.
